title: Saturday at the market
text:
Saturday 12 July

Dear Diary,

Today I went to the market with Mum. We got there early, at seven o'clock, because Mum says the fish is freshest in the morning.

First, we bought tomatoes, chillies and onions. Next, Mum chose a big fish. The fish seller wrapped it in paper. Then we stopped at my favourite stall. The lady there sells little cakes made with coconut. Mum let me choose two, a green one and a pink one.

On the way home, it started to rain. We ran under a shop roof and waited. I ate my green cake while we waited!

It was a busy morning, but I loved it.

Kirana
